mapper.select: SELECT ra.*, s.StudentName, a.AdminName FROM RechargeApplicationDEMS ra LEFT JOIN StudentDEMS s ON ra.StudentId = s.StudentId LEFT JOIN AdminDEMS a ON ra.AdminId = a.AdminId WHERE ra.StudentId = #{studentId} ORDER BY ra.ApplyTime DESC

SELECT ra.*, s.StudentName, a.AdminName FROM RechargeApplicationDEMS ra LEFT JOIN StudentDEMS s ON ra.StudentId = s.StudentId LEFT JOIN AdminDEMS a ON ra.AdminId = a.AdminId WHERE ra.Status = #{status} ORDER BY ra.ApplyTime DESC
